accepted.s: The National Environmental Engineering Research Institute (NEERI) was established in which year?
accepted.x: NEERI was established in 1958. It is located in Nagpur and is associated with environmental engineering.
accepted.tq: Use the year options to distinguish closely spaced institutional dates.
accepted.sec: CSIR laboratories → location, founding year, field

accepted.s: NEERI-ZAR, developed by the National Environmental Engineering Research Institute, is primarily associated with which of the following?
accepted.x: NEERI-ZAR is a gravity water purifier that operates without electricity. It was developed by NEERI, Nagpur.
accepted.tq: Link the technology with the specialised field of its developing laboratory.
accepted.sec: CSIR laboratories → location, founding year, field

accepted.s: The Central Institute of Cellular and Molecular Biology (CCMB) was founded in:
accepted.x: CCMB was founded in 1977. Its work concerns cellular and molecular biology.
accepted.tq: Distinguish institutional years by matching the date with the laboratory’s field.
accepted.sec: CSIR laboratories → location, founding year, field

accepted.s: Which one of the following is associated with the zoo bio-bank mentioned in connection with CCMB?
accepted.x: The zoo bio-bank is associated with CCMB, whose principal field is cellular and molecular biology.
accepted.tq: Identify the laboratory from its distinctive specialised activity.
accepted.sec: CSIR laboratories → location, founding year, field

accepted.s: Saheli, the weekly oral contraceptive pill based on centchroman, was developed by:
accepted.x: Saheli, a centchroman-based weekly oral contraceptive, was developed by the Central Drug Research Institute (CDRI), Lucknow.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between laboratories in the same city by their signature technology.
accepted.sec: CSIR laboratories → location, founding year, field

accepted.s: The Central Drug Research Institute (CDRI) was established in:
accepted.x: CDRI was established in 1951 and is known for drug research and the development of Saheli.
accepted.tq: Use nearby year options to test precise institutional chronology.
accepted.sec: CSIR laboratories → location, founding year, field

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about CSIR laboratories:
1. CSMCRI is located at Bhavnagar in Gujarat.
2. CSMCRI is associated with salt, marine chemicals and desalination.
3. CSMCRI was established in 1959.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: CSMCRI is located at Bhavnagar and works on salt, marine chemicals and desalination. It was established in 1954, so statement 3 is false.
accepted.tq: Find the wrong date while retaining the correct location and field statements.
accepted.sec: CSIR laboratories → location, founding year, field

accepted.s: The Central Electrochemical Research Institute (CECRI) is located at:
accepted.x: CECRI is located at Karaikudi in Tamil Nadu. Its field includes electrochemistry and batteries.
accepted.tq: Match the institute with its distinctive location and nearby research field.
accepted.sec: CSIR laboratories → location, founding year, field

accepted.s: Which of the following pairs is correctly matched?
accepted.x: CIMAP was established in 1959 and is associated with medicinal and aromatic plants. The other pairs combine the wrong years or fields with the institutes.
accepted.tq: Check the institute-year-field combination rather than recognising only one component.
accepted.sec: CSIR laboratories → location, founding year, field

accepted.s: The National Chemical Laboratory (NCL), Pune, is associated with which technology?
accepted.x: NCL, Pune, is associated with methanol-to-DME technology, in which DME can serve as an LPG substitute.
accepted.tq: Identify a laboratory through its specialised technology rather than its location alone.
accepted.sec: CSIR laboratories → location, founding year, field

accepted.s: The Indian Institute of Chemical Technology (IICT) is located in:
accepted.x: IICT is located in Hyderabad. Its areas include chemical technology, drug discovery, catalysis and green chemistry.
accepted.tq: Use location-based recall while distinguishing neighbouring CSIR laboratories.
accepted.sec: CSIR laboratories → location, founding year, field

accepted.s: Which one of the following is NOT correctly matched?
accepted.x: NPL, New Delhi, is associated with national measurement standards and Indian Standard Time. Microbial technology is associated with IMTECH, Chandigarh.
accepted.tq: Find the swapped field in an institute-location-specialisation pair.
accepted.sec: CSIR laboratories → location, founding year, field

accepted.s: The National Geophysical Research Institute (NGRI) was established in:
accepted.x: NGRI was established in 1961. It works in geophysics, earthquakes and groundwater studies.
accepted.tq: Separate close institutional years using the associated research discipline.
accepted.sec: CSIR laboratories → location, founding year, field

accepted.s: Which CSIR laboratory maintains national measurement standards and keeps Indian Standard Time?
accepted.x: The National Physical Laboratory (NPL), New Delhi, maintains national measurement standards and keeps Indian Standard Time.
accepted.tq: Identify the institution from a unique statutory or national function.
accepted.sec: CSIR laboratories → location, founding year, field

accepted.s: IMTECH is particularly associated with which of the following?
o: MTCC gene bank and microbial technology
accepted.x: IMTECH, Chandigarh, works in microbial technology and hosts the MTCC gene bank, an IDA under the Budapest Treaty.
accepted.tq: Use a distinctive repository or technical facility as the identifying clue.
accepted.sec: CSIR laboratories → location, founding year, field

accepted.s: Which one of the following CSIR laboratories was established earliest?
accepted.x: IICT was established in 1944, earlier than NPL in 1947, CECRI in 1948 and NCL in 1950.
accepted.tq: Arrange institutional years from the earliest date instead of relying on present prominence.
accepted.sec: CSIR laboratories → location, founding year, field

accepted.s: The National Biotechnology Board was upgraded to a Department in 1986. It had been established in 1982 with the participation of which group of organisations?
o: MoES, ICAR, ICMR and NITI Aayog
accepted.x: The National Biotechnology Board was established in 1982 with DST, UGC, ICMR and CSIR, and was upgraded to the Department of Biotechnology in 1986.
accepted.tq: Recall the founding participants and distinguish them from adjacent science bodies.
accepted.sec: DBT - autonomous institutes → location, and BIRAC

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements about BRIC:
1. BRIC was established in 2023.
2. It integrates 14 DBT institutions.
3. It is chaired by the Union Minister for Science and Technology.
4. The DBT Secretary serves as its ex officio Director-General.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements are correct. BRIC was established in 2023 as an apex body integrating 14 DBT institutions, with the Union S&T Minister as Chair and the DBT Secretary as ex officio Director-General.
accepted.tq: Test a compact institutional profile through several independently verifiable statements.
accepted.sec: DBT - autonomous institutes → location, and BIRAC

accepted.s: The National Institute of Immunology (NII) and the National Institute of Plant Genome Research (NIPGR) are both located in:
accepted.x: Both NII and NIPGR are located in New Delhi.
accepted.tq: Compare two institutions that share a location while differing in their research specialisation.
accepted.sec: DBT - autonomous institutes → location, and BIRAC

accepted.s: NCCS, which hosts the Microbial Culture Collection, is located at:
accepted.x: The National Centre for Cell Science (NCCS) is located in Pune and hosts the Microbial Culture Collection.
accepted.tq: Associate a repository with the correct institute and location.
accepted.sec: DBT - autonomous institutes → location, and BIRAC

accepted.s: The Regional Centre for Biotechnology (RCB) is located at:
accepted.x: RCB is located at Faridabad. It is distinct from CIAB at Mohali and NCCS at Pune.
accepted.tq: Distinguish similarly classified biotechnology institutions by location.
accepted.sec: DBT - autonomous institutes → location, and BIRAC

accepted.s: Which of the following is correctly matched?
accepted.x: The Centre of Innovative and Applied Bioprocessing (CIAB) is located at Mohali. NCCS is at Pune, RCB at Faridabad and NIPGR at New Delhi.
accepted.tq: Start with the sure institute-location pair and eliminate the swapped locations.
accepted.sec: DBT - autonomous institutes → location, and BIRAC

accepted.s: BIRAC is best described as:
o: A constitutional body regulating biotechnology education
A statutory authority for national measurement standards
A not-for-profit Section 8 company of DBT that funds biotechnology start-ups
A CSIR laboratory working on drug discovery
accepted.x: BIRAC, or Biotechnology Industry Research Assistance Council, is a not-for-profit Section 8 company of DBT established in 2012 to fund biotechnology start-ups.
accepted.tq: Discriminate between an institution’s legal form, parent department and function.
accepted.sec: DBT - autonomous institutes → location, and BIRAC

accepted.s: The Grand Challenge Award of BIRAC was given to CSIR-IGIB for which technology?
accepted.x: BIRAC’s Grand Challenge Award went to CSIR-IGIB’s FELUDA test.
accepted.tq: Link an award with the specific technology and developing institution.
accepted.sec: DBT - autonomous institutes → location, and BIRAC

accepted.s:
The NEERI-ZAR gravity water purifier has which of the following features?
1. It does not require electricity.
2. It was supplied to Assam during floods.
3. Its stated capacity is 2,500 litres per hour.

accepted.x: NEERI-ZAR works without electricity, 100 units were supplied during the Assam floods, and its stated capacity is 2,500 litres per hour.
accepted.tq: Combine operational features, deployment details and a numerical specification.

accepted.s: CSIR was set up in September 1942 as:
o: An autonomous body registered as a society
A statutory corporation under the Ministry of Education
accepted.x: CSIR was set up in September 1942 as an autonomous body and is registered as a society.

accepted.s:
Consider the following statements regarding the leadership of CSIR:
1. The Prime Minister is its ex officio President.
2. The Union Science and Technology Minister is its Vice-President.
3. The Director-General of CSIR is also Secretary, DSIR.
4. The Director-General of CSIR heads the Governing Body.
Which of the statements given above are correct?
accepted.x: All four statements correctly describe the leadership structure of CSIR. The Prime Minister is ex officio President, while the Union S&T Minister is Vice-President.
accepted.tq: Test constitutional-style offices and ex officio positions through a complete institutional profile.
accepted.sec: CSIR - setup year, ex-officio president, structure, number of labs

accepted.s: The CSIR network comprises which of the following?
o: 39 national laboratories, 37 outreach centres, 1 innovation complex and 3 units
37 national laboratories, 39 outreach centres, 3 innovation complexes and 1 unit
37 national laboratories, 39 outreach centres, 1 innovation complex and 3 units
39 national laboratories, 37 outreach centres, 3 innovation complexes and 1 unit
accepted.x: The CSIR network consists of 37 national laboratories, 39 outreach centres, 1 innovation complex and 3 units.
accepted.tq: Separate closely similar counts by reading the institutional structure as a complete set.
accepted.sec: CSIR - setup year, ex-officio president, structure, number of labs

accepted.s: The CSIR network has more than how many scientists?
accepted.x: The CSIR network has more than 3,300 scientists.
accepted.tq: Identify the correct magnitude from closely spaced numerical options.
accepted.sec: CSIR - setup year, ex-officio president, structure, number of labs

accepted.s:
Which of the following statements about the Bose Institute is correct?

2. It is an autonomous institute under DST.
